subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap:
- You’re planning to move the new conversational feature into production in Q3.
- Target steady-state throughput: ~220 reqs/sec (95th percentile), avg request size ~350 tokens, peak burst up to ~1k reqs/sec for short periods.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end latency under 300ms for critical routes.
- Important attendees: your SRE + data engineering (to validate telemetry/ingestion), and our infra engineer for kernel/quantization guidance.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep dive) so we can align on exact throughput, latency testing plan, and the sizing template. Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 23 Mar, 9:00–10:00am
- Tue 23 Mar, 3:00–4:00pm
- Wed 24 Mar, 11:00–12:00pm

Can you confirm which time works and if Taylor (SRE) and anyone from data eng will join? I’m copying Dylan (solutions engineer) to join the call.

I’ve attached a short capacity requirements template to fill ahead of the meeting — helps us come prepared.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
T: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: capacity_requirements_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeinc.com>

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the template. All looks good. Taylor (cc’d) is our SRE lead and will definitely join. I’ll try to also bring Luis from data engineering — he’ll confirm tomorrow.

Of the times you suggested, Wed 24 Mar 11:00am PST works best for us. If that fills up, Tue 23 Mar 3pm is our second choice.

We’ll aim to pre-populate the template with current traffic profiles and a short replay of recent production spikes.

Regards,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product — Acme, Inc.
alex.johnson@acmeinc.com

Subject: Re: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call — pre-call questions

Thanks Marissa — adding a few technical asks we typically cover in the sizing session so Alex/Taylor/Luis can prep:

1) Traffic shape (P50/P95/P99) by route + sample payload sizes.
2) Current model variants in prod (quantized/int8/fp16) and any constrained ops.
3) Auth and telemetry: what tracing/metrics will you expose during the load tests (prometheus, datadog, etc.).
4) Day-1 failover expectations and multi-region needs.

Also attaching a quick pre-call question list — if you can have Taylor or Luis fill the relevant sections it speeds the session. We’ll allocate 30–45 minutes for architecture discussion and 30–45 minutes for hands-on throughput/latency planning and preliminary cost estimate.

Camila Reyes
Infrastructure Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
